display_name: Backfill Orphan Running Batches for Source
description:
Cycle 4b D11 — operator-only one-shot repair for stale orphan `session_ledger__import_batch` rows on one source. Marks any running batch whose `started_at` is older than `stale_threshold_seconds` (default 86400 s = 24 h) as `status='failed'` with `error_kind='orphan_repair'`. Does NOT filter on `polling_lease_token` so Wave 4a token-owned batches whose owner crashed after claim are reachable. Defense-in-depth: `source_kind`, when supplied, must match the source row's actual kind; mismatch returns all-zero counts (operator pointing at wrong source by id sees an honest no-op).

Why this verb exists. Two orphan-batch generation paths converge here. (1) `register_chatgpt_export_source` (Cycle 1) inserts a `status='running'` batch row at upload-route time; if its kickoff `trigger_poll` raises (Bug A's AttributeError, Bug D's blob-storage typo) the row is never finished and sits orphan. (2) After Wave 4a's `polling_lease_token` lands, the importer's `_poll_one_pulling_source` claims a batch's token; if the process crashes between start_batch and finish_batch, the batch is owned but unreachable.

Dry-run gate. Default `confirm=false` returns the structured count envelope — `total_orphan_count_before` (all running batches for source at start of call), `repaired_count=0`, `untouched_count=0`, `source_id` echo. Operator inspects the count, then re-runs with `confirm=true`. Idempotent: on a source with no stale orphans, `confirm=true` returns `repaired_count=0`. Invariant: `total_orphan_count_before == repaired_count + untouched_count`.

This verb is `is_discoverable=false` — model cannot find it via `process_search` and never proposes it. Operator-only via the operator bridge.
embedding_description: Operator-only one-shot repair: mark stale running __import_batch rows for one source as failed (error_kind='orphan_repair'). Targets orphans from (a) Cycle 1 chatgpt upload-route kickoff failures and (b) Wave 4a crash-after-claim under polling_lease_token. Source-scoped; optional source_kind cross-check. Stale threshold default 86400s. Default dry-run; confirm=true. Idempotent.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Backfill Orphan Running Batches for Source
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Orphan-batch repair outcome for one source. `confirmed=false` is a dry-run with `total_orphan_count_before` as the size signal. `confirmed=true` reports `repaired_count` (stale batches marked failed) and `untouched_count` (recent batches left running within the stale-grace window). The invariant `total_orphan_count_before == repaired_count + untouched_count` lets the operator sanity-check the verb's result envelope.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: On `confirmed=true`, confirm the next `trigger_poll` cron firing (within 5 min) creates a fresh batch row and walks normally. If `untouched_count > 0`, those are running batches WITHIN the stale-grace window — let them finish or shorten `stale_threshold_seconds` and re-run. If `total_orphan_count_before == 0`, the source has no orphan running batches (clean state).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One-shot UPDATE marking stale `__import_batch.status='running'` rows on one source as `status='failed'` with `error_kind='orphan_repair'`.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: LedgerRepositoryError: the underlying state_service rejected the UPDATE, the dry-run COUNT, or the after-state COUNT. Possible causes: schema not yet initialized, state_service unavailable, or transient connection failure mid-transaction.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm `list_sources` returns the active source roster (proves state_service is responsive). The verb is idempotent — re-run with the same arguments after addressing the underlying state_service issue. If the source_id you passed doesn't exist, the verb returns zero counts (no error).
